assumptions.statement: The public package and registered official public references have been reviewed, but applicable official boundary and key-area polygons, adopted plan sheets, parcel controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire-safety, heritage and engineering constraints remain unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All spatial quantities and interventions remain conceptual recommendations. At G0, the appointed planning lead must replace provisional geometry, reject adjacent-parcel value transfer and regenerate the full package before statutory or construction use.

assumptions.statement: The submitted overall and key-area polygons are copied from the repository provisional boundary source.
assumptions.impact: They support reproducible design comparison only and must not be read as official redlines or precise cadastral limits.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints express concept carriers for program testing, not surveyed existing buildings or approved new construction.
assumptions.impact: Retain, renovate and new-concept labels require field survey, ownership checks and professional review.

assumptions.statement: Every public AI pilot requires a named steward, minimum-data statement, human checkpoint, non-digital alternative where applicable, appeal route and sunset condition.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is eligible for scaling solely because its technical prototype works.

assumptions.statement: Neon colors are a visual identity and status code, not a blanket lighting specification.
assumptions.impact: Any physical lighting requires low-glare, curfew, energy, ecological and heritage review.

assumptions.statement: The 100-metre interface, 100-day limit, RACI roles, service levels and six delivery gates are proposer-defined admission conditions for a removable pilot.
assumptions.impact: They are not an approved location, appointed delivery body, procurement plan, government SLA or construction commitment; Gate 0 and named accountable roles are required before any live test.

assumptions.statement: Five regional interfaces describe candidate inputs, minimum outputs and exit gates with Beiwei Community, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, Beijing E-Town and the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region.
assumptions.impact: No partnership, data-sharing agreement, funding, policy alignment or participation by those parties is claimed.

assumptions.statement: People, space, devices, data/licensing/compliance, maintenance, and exit/deletion/restoration are six mandatory cost ledgers; no evidence-based currency total is available.
assumptions.impact: The public pilot cannot pass Gate 1 until every ledger has an owner, funding source, quote or workload basis, maintenance provision and exit provision.
